question: Two trains having lengths of 370 m and 330 m are running at speeds of 90 km/h and 150 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to cross = 370 + 330 = 700 m

Relative speed (same direction) = 150 − 90 = 60 km/h

Speed in m/min = (60 × 1000) ÷ 60 = 1000 m/min

Time taken = Distance ÷ Speed = 700 ÷ 1000 = 0.7 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of slower train (L₁) = 370 m

Length of faster train (L₂) = 330 m

Speed of slower train (S₁) = 90 km/h

Speed of faster train (S₂) = 150 km/h

 
 
• 
 
 
 
 370 m
 90 km/h →

 
 
 330 m
 150 km/h →
 
 
 

 Total Distance = 700 m

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Relative Speed (same direction) = S₂ − S₁

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5 ÷ 18)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 370 + 330 = 700 m

⇒ Relative Speed = 150 − 90 = 60 km/h

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 60 × (5 ÷ 18) = 50 ÷ 3 m/s

⇒ Time taken in seconds = 700 ÷ (50 ÷ 3)

⇒ Time taken = (700 × 3) ÷ 50 = 42 seconds

⇒ Convert seconds to minutes = 42 ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken = 0.7 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗₐₜᵢvₑ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗₐₜᵢvₑ = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing Objects with Length

When a train crosses another train, a platform, or a bridge, the total distance covered is equal to the sum of the lengths of the train and the object.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by (5 ÷ 18). To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply by (18 ÷ 5).
